verification.method: scripts/verify/argentina.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank 2026/2100, share, growth, density, land area; third in South America after Brazil and Colombia; about 2.7 times 1950
Births peak 2014 and 2026 (down about a third); fertility 2015, under 2.1 from 2018, 2022 low, now; fourth-lowest among Latin American countries over 5 million
Urban share 1950/2026/2050, highest among Latin American countries over 10 million
Net migration 2026 and 1950; life expectancy 1950/now; peak 2050 = first year of natural decrease; 2100 total
Title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 69 of 69 checks match
